items: Let me sleep on it.
I'll decide tomorrow. — Nice offer. Let me sleep on it.
Give me a ballpark figure.
A rough number is fine. — How much? Just give me a ballpark figure.
Can you meet me halfway?
Let's both give a little. — Too high for me. Can you meet me halfway?
You've got yourself a deal.
I agree, we're done. — Two hundred each? You've got yourself a deal.
That's my bottom line.
My final price, no lower. — Ninety dollars. That's my bottom line.
Let's call it even.
Nobody owes anybody now. — You paid last time, so let's call it even.
I'll throw in free shipping.
I'll add it for free. — Take fifty units and I'll throw in free shipping.
It's a win-win.
Good for both sides. — You save money, I move stock. It's a win-win.
Don't lowball me.
Don't offer me too little. — Come on, don't lowball me, this is top quality.
We'll make it work.
We'll find a way. — Tight deadline, but we'll make it work.
How's it going?
The everyday hello. — Hey Mike! How's it going?
You bet.
Of course, happily. — Can you send it today? You bet.
No big deal.
It's nothing, don't worry. — Sorry I'm late. No big deal.
I'm gonna head out.
I'm leaving now. — It's getting late, I'm gonna head out.
Wanna grab a bite?
Want to get some food? — I'm starving. Wanna grab a bite?
Lemme know.
Tell me when you decide. — Think about it and lemme know.
It turns out he was right.
We discovered he was right. — I doubted him, but it turns out he was right.
That makes sense.
I understand, it's logical. — Ship first, pay later? That makes sense.
I'm all set.
I'm ready — or I have enough. — Need anything else? No, I'm all set.
Take it easy.
Relax — also a way to say goodbye. — See you Friday. Take it easy!
Way to go, buddy!
Great job — dads say this a lot. — You got an A? Way to go, buddy!
I've got your back.
I will protect and support you. — Don't be scared. I've got your back.
Give it your best shot.
Try as hard as you can. — The test is hard, so give it your best shot.
Use your words.
Say it calmly, don't cry or shout. — Hey, hey — use your words.
High five!
Hands up, we celebrate! — You finished your homework? High five!
Because I said so.
The classic dad answer. — Why bedtime now? Because I said so.
I'm proud of you, son.
The words every kid waits for. — You told the truth. I'm proud of you, son.
One more chapter, then bed.
Reading together at night. — Please? Okay — one more chapter, then bed.
Easy does it.
Slowly and carefully. — Carrying the glass? Easy does it.
You did the right thing.
Your choice was correct and good. — You returned the money. You did the right thing.
Count your blessings.
Remember the good things you have. — Bad day? Count your blessings.
It's in God's hands.
We did our part; the rest is His. — We sent the offer. Now it's in God's hands.
This too shall pass.
Hard times end. — Business is slow, but this too shall pass.
Actions speak louder than words.
What you do matters more than what you say.
Honesty is the best policy.
Telling the truth always wins in the end.
Charity begins at home.
Take care of your family first, then the world.
Patience pays off.
Waiting calmly brings rewards. — Ten years of work, and patience paid off.
Forgive and forget.
Let it go completely. — He apologized. Forgive and forget.
Peace of mind is priceless.
A calm heart is worth more than money.
God willing, we'll get there.
With His help, we will succeed.
